title: "parameter has already been declared" (ParameterAlreadyDeclaredException) in ROS 2: use_sim_time, auto-declared overrides, plugins and lifecycle on_configure, measured
excerpt: Why rclpy and rclcpp throw ParameterAlreadyDeclaredException: declaring use_sim_time, automatically_declare_parameters_from_overrides, two helpers on one node and lifecycle on_configure, plus has_parameter, prefixes, catching and undeclare compared on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
